rows.grounds: compound bhāgya-hīna describing those lacking good fortune
relative pronoun indicating the means; initial doubling noted
future destruction or removal of sorrow; initial doubling noted

items.question: Through what agency is the suffering of fortune-deprived people eliminated?
premises: Some people are devoid of good fortune.
A specific agency can destroy that sorrow.
items.inference: Therefore, there exists a means by which the sorrow of the unfortunate is eliminated.
uncertainties: The doubled initial consonants in yyena and vvinaśyati may reflect scribal or orthographic variation.
items.plain_english: By which the sorrow of people devoid of fortune will be destroyed.
